notes.title: We're BACK!
notes.content: [h1]Head Coach Tactics back in full development!!![/h1][p][/p][p]That's right, after a 2-year pause, we're back!!  There are quite a few changes and updates to the core concept of the game, (way too many new things to list them all right now) but the biggest ones are:[/p][olist][*][p]Switch from 8v8 football to full 11v11 football[/p][/*][*][p]Added college league![/p][/*][/olist][p][/p][p]As a teaser, here is the current in-game menu.  Hopefully this gives you a taste of what's coming.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43802312/19b1f267716802b91ac186306131f678f6ba47ea.png"][/img][/p]
